stemMarkdown: Evaluate $\dfrac{1}{1 + \sqrt{3}}$ as a decimal. (Round to 6 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Multiply top and bottom by the conjugate $1 - \sqrt{3}$: $\dfrac{1 - \sqrt{3}}{1^2 - 3} = \dfrac{1 - \sqrt{3}}{-2} = 0.366025$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Rationalising does not change the value — it just moves the irrational part to the numerator.
